purpose: Prevent consumption of a fresh response endpoint before source architecture, response semantics, target estimability, geometry and transport are independently qualified.
applies_to: future fresh real-system tests of calibration-only selective promotion after known-truth support
automatic_pre_response_rejects: effort table contains biological detections needed for modeling
live source metadata/transport fails under the frozen route
exact response header or response algebra cannot be independently frozen
target inclusion is only assumed from ecological plausibility rather than independently documented
fewer than 50 unique public spatial nodes
required spatial nodes are collapsed to coarse site centroids
source has already been response-consumed by an EOG attempt

lessons_fixed_from_consumed_or_stopped_a.massachusetts_wildlife: pre-response STOP because visits.csv mixed required effort/time information with track_sign biological detections
lessons_fixed_from_consumed_or_stopped_a.rhode_island_wildlife: pre-response STOP because the prospectively frozen metadata request timed out; no retry allowed
lessons_fixed_from_consumed_or_stopped_a.neon_camera: post-response estimability STOP because target inclusion was assumed but the frozen exact-name target produced zero eligible positives
lessons_fixed_from_consumed_or_stopped_a.raccoon_rabies: post-response schema STOP because public prose was not sufficient to freeze exact spaced headers and negative-count algebra
lessons_fixed_from_consumed_or_stopped_a.uljin_korea: pre-response reject before any EOG attempt because 82 stations are represented by only two public site-level generalized coordinate points
